post.description: Executes a typed command for the authenticated owner. Validates catalog parameters, current eligibility and sleep/recovery state before service dispatch. Known success or rejection includes refreshed context; an observation failure preserves the known result or rejection with requires_context_refresh=true. Recover by GET context without replaying the command. Unknown, unconnected and unexpected failures use their documented error responses. Per-action schemas are supplied by context; domain services validate exact prerequisites.

parameters.description: Owned character ID; actor identity cannot be overridden in params
parameters.name: id

requestBody.description: One JSON document, at most 64 KiB; Content-Type must be application/json. adventure_start params accepts only required non-null string stage_id; rescue_request accepts only required non-null string reason. home_sleep accepts only optional string target_home_id; home_wake accepts no fields. Home commands accept omitted params or an empty object. Actor identity comes from the owned path; target_home_id never overrides it. bank_deposit/bank_withdraw accept only required non-null integer amount (int64); missing/null/wrong-type/out-of-range inputs are rejected before execution, while typed nonpositive or excessive values reach Bank service validation. Navigation params are strict: scene_enter requires a registered destination; scene_select requires the registered target_kind and an available target_id. scene_page requires matching destination and exactly one of offset 0..1000000 or cursor, with optional limit 1..100 (default 20), only on a pageable list with no selected subject. Only Home inbox/outbox accept cursors; Town and Shops are offset-only. scene_back accepts omitted params or an empty object. Null fields and arbitrary targets are rejected. depot_expand accepts omitted params or an empty object only: no actor, target, count or cost fields. Shared strict decoding and entry/activity/recovery guards apply. depot_deposit/depot_withdraw/depot_sell require non-null string item_id; depot_send_item requires non-null string item_id and recipient_character_id, with actor identity only from the owned path; depot_sell_batch requires non-null item_ids, an array of non-null strings. depot_send_money requires a non-null integer amount (int64) and non-null string recipient_character_id; nonpositive or excessive amounts reach Depot service validation. These commands reject unknown fields, actor, price and quantity overrides. Empty strings/arrays, duplicate or absent owned IDs reach service validation; no automatic selection or transport batch-size limit is imposed. challenge_retire requires only non-null session_id (nonempty string) and expected_revision (positive integer); the actor is the authenticated character. Invalid identity values conflict before domain execution. auction_send accepts only optional non-null target_character_id, target_character_name, slot, instance_id (strings) and gold (signed integer). The service requires a recipient and something to send; ID takes precedence over name, positive gold over items, and slot over instance_id. No sender override is accepted. npc_talk, npc_inspect and secretshop_puffpuff accept omitted params or an empty object; the facility comes from the owner's current scene. player_inspect accepts only optional non-null target_character_id and target_character_name (strings) in any scene; ID takes precedence, and an omitted or missing target inspects the actor.

200.description: Known command success; adventure_start result contains id, character_id, stage_id, started_at, floors_cleared, is_cleared, party_size, resolved and experience_reward, as on POST /adventures. rescue_request returns the existing RescueRecord: id, character_id, reason, penalty_seconds, created_at, including idle/no-op results. home_sleep result reuses the REST sleep response: sleeping, duration_seconds, remaining_seconds, home_character_id, message. home_wake result reuses the REST wake response: success, message, character. Refresh failure preserves success/result with null context and CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED. Bank results preserve character_id, money, deposit, amount and message as on REST; withdrawal also returns actual_withdrawn and refunded for wallet overflow returned to savings. Navigation result uses NavigationSelection; refreshed typed scene reports selection_unavailable without substituting a fallback. Depot sales return depot (character_id, capacity, ex_depot, item_count, items with ID/definition/quantity) and gold_earned; enhancement facts remain in refreshed context. challenge_retire returns ChallengeRetireResult (actor-owned receipt plus recovery_pending); a committed receipt remains success when publication is pending. Identical explicit actor/run/revision retries use the domain receipt after departure. Clients recover lost responses or context refresh failures by GET active challenge, command receipt and context; never automatically replay POST. auction_send returns AuctionSendResult, preserving the actual recipient, gold or transferred item instance/definition/name/enhancement and message. player_inspect returns PlayerInspection: the public status of the target (never wallet money), guild, custom-skill gem IDs and aligned catalog names, login message, presence and coarse location. Offline location is null; actual activity reports quest before saved scene selection, otherwise the registered scene or Home owner is returned. Activity IDs, phases and members stay private; required source failures are unexpected execution errors. Gem Store commands return the service results: gem_box with the gem and cost (buy), payout (sell), created_gem and recipe (synthesize), identified_gem/is_gem/message (appraise). gemstore_send returns only the sender's gem_box, the sent gem and the recipient's recipient_character_id/recipient_character_name; the recipient's character state and gem box are never returned. Flea Market commands return the service results: listing (fleamarket_list, fleamarket_cancel); fleamarket_purchase returns the purchased listing, buyer_gold and item_instance; the seller's wallet balance or other seller state is never returned.

400.description: Malformed outer JSON uses the existing transport error. Invalid typed params return INVALID_ACTION_PARAMS without execution/context. Rescue service invalid actor ID returns RESCUE_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID with refreshed context when possible. Bank service rejections use BANK_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID, BANK_INVALID_AMOUNT, BANK_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, BANK_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and BANK_DEPOSIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; known rejections retain their code if refresh fails. Invalid navigation scene/subject/page returns INVALID_SELECTION with refresh; malformed typed inputs return INVALID_ACTION_PARAMS. Depot sale rejections use DEPOT_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID, DEPOT_INVALID_ITEM_INSTANCE_ID, DEPOT_EMPTY_ITEM_LIST, DEPOT_INVALID_AMOUNT and DEPOT_INVALID_QUANTITY. Auction send rejections use AUCTION_SELF_TRANSFER, AUCTION_INVALID_TARGET, AUCTION_NOTHING_TO_SEND, AUCTION_INVALID_AMOUNT, AUCTION_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, AUCTION_DEPOT_FULL, AUCTION_TABOO_ITEM, AUCTION_ITEM_NOT_EQUIPPED and AUCTION_INVALID_SLOT.

401.description: Missing or invalid session; no context.

403.description: Authentication/ownership rejection exposes no context. Adventure service rejects level/job-level requirements with ADVENTURE_LEVEL_REQUIRED / ADVENTURE_JOB_LEVEL_REQUIRED and refreshes when possible. Challenge ownership rejection uses CHALLENGE_FORBIDDEN.

404.description: Unknown ActionID: ACTION_NOT_FOUND. Missing character uses transport error; Adventure/Rescue/Home/Bank service character-not-found returns CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND. Home rejects missing/expired destination houses with HOME_HOUSE_NOT_FOUND / HOME_HOUSE_EXPIRED. Known service rejections refresh context when possible. An absent or unavailable product returns SELECTION_NOT_FOUND. Depot sale missing targets/storage or character return DEPOT_ITEM_NOT_FOUND, DEPOT_NOT_FOUND or CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND with refreshed context when possible. Missing Challenge runs use CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND. Auction uses AUCTION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND or AUCTION_ITEM_NOT_FOUND with refreshed context when possible.

409.description: Current entry or Sleep/CanWake exclusion: ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Home service rejections: HOME_ALREADY_SLEEPING, HOME_STILL_SLEEPING (early Wake does not restore vitality), HOME_NOT_SLEEPING, HOME_WAKE_IN_PROGRESS. Preserves the recognized rejection and refreshes context when possible. Challenge revision or different-action receipt conflicts use CHALLENGE_REVISION_CONFLICT. Rescue returns RESCUE_ACTIVITY_REMAINING without changes while party, PvP (including unpublished claims), GvG, dungeon, challenge, casino or adventure activity remains.

415.description: Content-Type must be application/json; no execution/context.

422.description: Adventure service rejections: ADVENTURE_STAGE_NOT_FOUND, ADVENTURE_STAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE, ADVENTURE_UNCONSCIOUS, ADVENTURE_EXHAUSTED, ADVENTURE_DAILY_LIMIT. Rescue rejects empty/blank reason with RESCUE_INVALID_REASON. Preserves the mapped code and refreshes when possible; current catalog exclusion instead returns 409 ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Inactive Challenge runs use CHALLENGE_NOT_ACTIVE.

500.description: Authorization read failure uses transport error. ACTION_PREFLIGHT_FAILED stops execution on state-read failure. EXECUTION_FAILED leaves mutation outcome unknown; neither failure returns context.

501.description: Known unconnected ID or unconfigured dependency: ACTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no execution/context.

Delivery/notice persistence failures roll back creation.
